# Permissions

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen_permissions_doc.py from each package's policies.py and app/authz/role_templates.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Keys are `module.resource[.sub].action`. A grant has a scope: **Self** (records the person owns), **Team** (their direct and indirect reports), **Department** (their department and those under it) or **Organisation**. Records outside a person's scope answer 404. See ADR 0013.

## Catalogue

### audit

| Key | Permission | Scopes | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `audit.log.read` | Read the audit log | Organisation | yes | See every sign-in, change and denied action. |

### authz

| Key | Permission | Scopes | Sensitive | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `authz.assignment.manage` | Assign roles | Organisation | yes | Give people roles, including temporary ones. |
| `authz.delegation.manage` | Manage everyone's delegations | Organisation |  | See and revoke delegations between any two people. |
| `authz.role.manage` | Manage roles | Organisation | yes | Create, edit and delete roles. |
| `authz.role.read` | View roles | Organisation |  | See roles and their permissions. |

## Role templates

Each installation starts with an editable copy of every template (Super Administrator excepted: it is protected). Business templates gain grants as their modules arrive. Scope letters: S self, T team, D department, O organisation.

### Super Administrator (two-step required, protected)

Everything, including technical settings. Can't be edited or removed.

| Permission | Scope |
|---|---|
| `audit.log.read` | O |
| `authz.assignment.manage` | O |
| `authz.delegation.manage` | O |
| `authz.role.manage` | O |
| `authz.role.read` | O |
| `hr.employee.create` | O |
| `hr.employee.read` | O |
| `hr.employee.update` | O |
| `identity.user.invite` | O |
| `identity.user.manage` | O |
| `identity.user.read` | O |
| `org.assignment.manage` | O |
| `org.structure.manage` | O |
| `org.structure.read` | O |
| `system.branding.manage` | O |
| `system.mail.manage` | O |
| `system.security.manage` | O |

### Auditor

Reads everything, including the audit log. Changes nothing.

| Permission | Scope |
|---|---|
| `audit.log.read` | O |
| `authz.role.read` | O |
| `hr.employee.read` | O |
| `identity.user.read` | O |
| `org.structure.read` | O |

## Separation of duties

| Rule | When performing | Blocked if | Message |
|---|---|---|---|
| `authz.no_self_assignment` | `authz.assignment.manage` | subject_is_actor | You can't change your own roles. Ask another administrator. |

Also enforced in app/authz/service.py: nobody can grant (to a role, a person or a delegate) a permission they don't hold themselves, or more widely than they hold it. Delegations last at most the configured number of days (default 90) and can't include `authz.*` or `system.*` permissions.
